correctness.rationale: Cyclotomic conjugacy reduces binary-collision differences to a single rational DFT order shell; CRT decomposition into prime-power shells and the general tensor-product minimum support inequality prove (N/d)2^omega(d). A tensor of +/-1 local witnesses realizes the bound within differences of binary words, with every quantifier and special case d=1 covered. A separate exact checker exhaustively verifies N<=10 and checks larger constructive examples; it is not relied on as proof.

originality.rationale: The accepted claim is a sharp minimum separation theorem after each deletion, not the prior one-per-divisor uniqueness theorem or existing ambiguity-pair constructions. Pei--Chang 2022 and Levinson--Viviano 2025 already supply qualitative loss of uniqueness and explicit upper-bound patterns; the converse support lower bound for every possible signed difference is established by prime-power zero-sum spaces and tensor-product minimum distance. Iosevich--Mayeli 2023 addresses different Fourier recovery bounds. Primary 2022 full text is inaccessible; priority remains provisional and the residual risk is recorded.
residual_risks: The 2022 Pei--Chang full text remained inaccessible; it may prove a stronger minimization theorem beyond its publicly available abstract and later summaries.
A coding-theoretic theorem for rational irreducible cyclotomic subspaces may give the identical minimum distance under different terminology.
Search results and database partitioning cannot certify historical uniqueness.

value.rationale: The natural invariant is the sharp minimum number of altered binary coordinates that can escape observation when precisely one of the indispensable Fourier samples is lost. The all-divisor formula and worst-erasure value reveal factorization-dependent robustness absent from qualitative unique-recovery results. Its precise value can determine sparse-change detection thresholds and is proved by a nontrivial universal lower-bound argument; this is a motivated quantitative classification rather than a routine numeric increment.
